en.hubeali:
And by this chain, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Sleep of the Fasting-one is worship, and his breathing is Glorification’.
en.sarwar: 12. It is narrated, through the same chain (narrators of previous Hadith), who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that
a fasting person’s sleeping is also counted as worshipping and his breathing as speaking of the glory of Allah.”
